notes: A new Conda environment was created from environment.yml with setup_environment.sh; the existing package cache was available.
Environment YAML and setup-script snapshots were captured after creation, not at creation time.
The explicit manifest records installed package builds; it was not the input used to create this environment.
The previously restored code and data were reused; this job did not download GitHub/Zenodo assets or reinstall the archive.
The job verified 14 input checksums; BAMs were not rehashed during evidence capture.
Outputs were re-compared at capture; MeanRatio comparison uses stored report precision.
This does not establish independent biological truth or full-cohort reproducibility.
scope: Rebuilt Conda environment and two-sample observed-output reproduction
